details:
Are you bored of trolls?

are you done with kicking the same person creating another account and going to 10 group publics rampage and getting kicked from all of them suddenly joining your instance?

introducing Autogating!

autogating is an option to automatically prevent someone who has a certain number of kicks or/and bans in the last specified ammount of hours from joining your instance

Examples

if user was  kicked 7 times in the last 5 hours  from Group Publics deny the entrance.

↓

now imagine being able to change the variables in that line, so it could then become

↓

if user was  banned 2 times in the last 1 hours  from Group Publics deny the entrance.

↓

or even better

↓

if user was  kicked 2 times in the last 30 minutes  from Group+ deny the entrance.

why would you do this?

as trolls keep going from instance to instance, this will keep them away from having a troll spree as it will only target trolls, it will significantly slow down active trolls.

what if innocent?

well, there can be an entry request option so

[x]Autogating  [x]Appeals [x]Vote Entry

once the appeals are checked it will be possible for the gated people to write a message when appealing to the instance gate (this way if the appeal makes no sense you can always deny it)  the appeal message will then be visible to the role who has the Autogating appeal review permissions, while the ability to set the autogating will be the Autogating permission, this makes it possible to have a special staff member reviewing them

or even better

it could even be possible to have a "vote entry" permission to vote wether to let someone in or not, in that case if you assign this to members in the instance, they will decide who to let in, this fosters a sense of community and responsability like never before, all the members in the instance will think "it's our group and we decide." or just give this permission to all staff in the instance so they will vote entry.
title: Group Autogating with Vote Entry
